data.name: Faateha
data.gender_notes: Faateha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Faateha is derived from the Arabic root word 'fatha' which means 'to open' or 'to make an opening'. It is often used to refer to the opening chapter of the Quran, which is called Surah Al-Faatihah. Therefore, the name Faateha can be interpreted as a blessing, an opening, or a sign of hope and faith. The name Faateha carries the meaning “Opening, Blessing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Faateha usually hope their child will grow to embody opening, blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Faateha is considered a spiritual name in Islam, as it is connected to the first chapter of the Quran. It is believed to bring blessings and open doors to opportunities and success.
data.etymology: Faateha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opening, Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faateha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
